items.title: Register as job-seeking with the Agentur für Arbeit
items.quote: Bitte melden Sie sich unverzüglich bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend; sonst kann es Nachteile beim Arbeitslosengeld geben.
items.computation: § 38 Abs. 1 SGB III requires registering as job-seeking within three days of learning the exact end date of the employment, unless that end date is known more than three months in advance (then: three months before the end). The letter was personally handed over and the end date (03.12.2026, about two weeks later) was learned on 19.11.2026 — well under three months away — so the three-day rule applies: 19.11.2026 + 3 days = 22.11.2026 (a Sunday). As today is already 24.11.2026, this deadline has already passed; registration should be done immediately to limit any reduction of Arbeitslosengeld.

items.title: File Kündigungsschutzklage at the labour court
items.quote: Sie muss binnen drei Wochen nach Zugang dieses Schreibens erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter was personally handed over and receipt acknowledged on 19.11.2026 ('Persönlich übergeben am 19.11.2026 ... Empfang quittiert'), so Zugang is 19.11.2026. Under § 4 KSchG the three-week period to bring a Kündigungsschutzklage starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): 20.11.2026 is day 1. Three weeks later, per § 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB, is Thursday 10.12.2026, which is a normal working day (no shift needed under § 193 BGB).

items.title: Employment relationship ends
items.quote: Innerhalb der Probezeit kündigen wir das Arbeitsverhältnis mit der vereinbarten Frist von zwei Wochen, also zum 03.12.2026.
items.computation: The letter states the termination date directly as 03.12.2026; this is the last day of employment as printed, no further calculation needed.

items.title: Return work clothing and the transponder
items.quote: Ihre Arbeitskleidung und den Transponder geben Sie bitte am letzten Arbeitstag ab.
items.computation: The letter ties this task to the 'last working day', which per the termination clause is 03.12.2026 (the date the employment ends).

warnings: The calculated three-day deadline to register as job-seeking with the Agentur für Arbeit (around 22.11.2026) has already passed as of today (24.11.2026); register online or by phone immediately, as a delay can reduce Arbeitslosengeld (§ 159 SGB III).

The three-week deadline to file a Kündigungsschutzklage (by 10.12.2026) is a hard court deadline set by § 4 KSchG — if the person wants to challenge the dismissal, they should contact a lawyer, their union, or the Arbeitsgericht's Rechtsantragstelle well before that date, since Ordnung cannot file it for them.

The letter only gives an 'unverzüglich' instruction for the Agentur für Arbeit registration without a fixed calendar date; the exact statutory deadline depends on facts (e.g. exact date the end date became known) that could shift it slightly.
